fact: TCRA's Director General says the government, through TCRA, has established 800 digital clubs across the country, promoted from nursery school to university to build digital literacy and practical ICT skills.
Minister Angellah Kairuki said the government, through TCRA, has established 800 Digital Clubs aimed at developing ICT skills among citizens.
The Zanzibar ministry says it trained 1,015 citizens in digital skills (639 women, 376 men) between July 2025 and March 2026 and will continue ICT training through community centres.
The report says the Tanzania Digital Club has 711 clubs with 766 teachers and 1,878 students, and 3,798 teachers were trained on ICT equipment.
